# WORK ORDER 559 — Hero Select as a CAROUSEL

**Status:** IMPLEMENTED (agent worktree — not gated/committed; orchestrator reconciles)
**Owner design:** hero-select = a CAROUSEL. Hero on the LEFT, lore BELOW the hero,
stats on the RIGHT, prev/next carousel nav to move between heroes. Locked heroes
shown but not selectable. A clear Select/Confirm to proceed.
**Date:** 2026-06-28

---

## 1. RCA — the current hero-select screen (before)

- **Scene:** `Assets/Scenes/HeroSelect.unity` — a Camera + EventSystem + a
  **UIDocument** GameObject (UI Toolkit host), generated by
  `Assets/Editor/IntroFlowSceneBuilder.cs:91` (`BuildSelectScene(... TypeHeroSelect ...)`,
  attaches `DeNelle.Onboarding.HeroSelectController`). The host is a **UIDocument**, not
  a uGUI Canvas (`IntroFlowSceneBuilder.cs:130-138`).
- **Controller:** `Assets/_Modules/Onboarding/HeroSelectController.cs` — drives the screen.
  Per CLAUDE.md §8 it CLEARS the UXML root and **builds the entire tree in code**
  (`BuildScreen` at `HeroSelectController.cs:193`), so UXML never has to render.
- **Previous layout (WO-503 single-hero):** one big **HERO STAGE** for Grom (large
  portrait + backstory on the LEFT, stats panel on the RIGHT) over a **LOCKED, inert
  "coming later" row** of the other three heroes (`BuildHeroStage` `:353`,
  `BuildLockedCarousel` `:492`, `BuildLockedCard` `:516`). Grom was hard pre-selected;
  the other heroes were a static dimmed band, NOT navigable.
- **Roster data:** `Assets/_Modules/Onboarding/HeroCatalog.cs` — a static
  `HeroCardInfo[] Heroes` (Mage/Thrain, Knight/Grom, Ranger/Sylas, Cleric/Elara) with
  per-hero en.json key references (name/role/blurb), glyph, accent colour, and the
  stat pips (Hp/Attack/Speed) + signature ability name/desc (`HeroCatalog.cs:89-115`).
- **Copy / lore:** resolved at runtime from `Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/en.json`
  via `CanonStrings.Locale` — `hero.<class>.name/role/blurb` (`en.json:145-156`). The
  **lore = the existing `blurb`** (one rich sentence per hero).
- **Which are unlocked (V1):** only **Knight (Grom)** — `FeatureFlags.KnightOnly`
  (default ON, `FeatureFlags.cs:53`) + `SingleHero` (`:40`). The playable hero is a
  const `PlayableHero = HeroClass.Knight` (`HeroSelectController.cs:119`).
- **Selection + confirm:** Grom is pre-selected on build; `ChooseHero(PlayableHero)`
  persists immediately; the single **"Enter Elarion"** CTA calls `OnDiveVillageClicked`
  (`:800`) → `GameStateService.ChooseHero` (`PersistHero` `:831`) → `SceneRouter.GoCastle()`
  (`SceneRouter.cs:375`; the `BypassPetSelect` flag default-ON skips PetSelect).
- **Hero visual:** `ApplyPortrait` (`:628`) loads `Resources/HeroPortraits/<slug>`
  (slug map `SlugFor` `:849`: Grom/Thrain/Sylas/Elara), cover-fit, falling back to the
  catalog accent glyph. There is **no 3D hero preview on this screen** — it is a 2D
  portrait. (3D hero rigs live in-game / Gear-Preview, not the onboarding screen.)
- **Returning-player skip:** `IsIntroComplete` (`:170`) routes a save that already has a
  hero straight to the Castle before any UI builds (`OnEnable` `:138`).

## 2. The rebuild — a CAROUSEL (this WO)

Rebuilt `HeroSelectController.cs` (presentation only; **zero data change**) so the
centerpiece is a **navigable carousel** over the whole roster, per the owner design:

```
root (column, stone bg)
  roster panel (full screen)
    brand (title + subtitle)        <- unchanged
    gold divider
    eyebrow  "- CHOOSE YOUR HERO -"
    carousel (row, grows)
      < prev arrow (gold chip button)
      hero stage (grows; row landscape / column portrait)
        LEFT  : large hero image (focal) + LOCK badge when locked,
                with the LORE (name / role / blurb) directly BELOW the hero
        RIGHT : stats panel - HP / ATTACK / SPEED pips + signature ability
      > next arrow (gold chip button)
    index dots  ( filled/empty pips - current hero in the roster )
    footer : Select / Confirm CTA
```

- **Carousel nav:** `<` / `>` arrow buttons step `_carouselIndex` through
  `HeroCatalog.Heroes` (wrapping). Each step calls `PopulateStage(index)` which rebuilds
  the LEFT (image + lore) and RIGHT (stats) content and refreshes the lock badge / CTA /
  dots — the arrows, footer and dots are persistent. Opens on the playable hero (Grom).
- **Locked heroes shown but not selectable:** every hero is navigable (so the player can
  PREVIEW the coming roster — image, lore, stats all visible), but a non-playable hero
  shows a dark scrim + **LOCK badge** + "Coming Soon" over the image, and the **Select
  CTA is disabled and relabeled "Coming Soon"**. Only `PlayableHero` (Knight) is
  confirmable (`IsPlayable`). `_hasSelection` is true only on a playable hero.
- **Confirm:** on a playable hero the CTA reads "Enter Elarion" and is enabled →
  `OnDiveVillageClicked` (UNCHANGED) persists `_selectedHero` and routes via the existing
  `SceneRouter.GoCastle()` / `BypassPetSelect` path. Downstream flow (Castle / PetSelect
  hatch) is untouched.
- **Responsive:** the stage still reflows row<->column on orientation change
  (`ReflowForSize`); the carousel arrows stay on the sides.
- **Self-assert:** `VerifyStage` now asserts the stage columns + both arrows + the dots
  exist and the index is in range (replaces the old locked-row count assert).

## 3. What was reused (no reinvention)

- **Data:** `HeroCatalog.Heroes` + `HeroCardInfo` (name/role/blurb keys, glyph, accent,
  stat pips, ability) — unchanged.
- **Copy/lore:** en.json `hero.<class>.*` via `CanonStrings.Locale` — unchanged.
- **Selection + routing:** `GameStateService.ChooseHero`, `PersistHero`,
  `OnDiveVillageClicked`, `SceneRouter.GoCastle`, returning-player gate — unchanged.
- **Visual:** `ApplyPortrait`, `BuildStatRow`, `PipString`, `SetBorderWidth/Color`,
  `StyleCta`, the `ElarionUi` black+gold palette — reused.
- **Host:** the existing UIDocument scene + IntroFlowSceneBuilder wiring — untouched.

## 4. Owner-decision flags

1. **ElarionUiKit is uGUI; this screen is UI Toolkit.** The owner asked to style with
   `DeNelle.Core.UI.ElarionUiKit`, but that kit builds **uGUI** (Canvas/Image/TMP) and
   the HeroSelect scene host is a **UIDocument** (UI Toolkit). Converting would require
   rewriting `IntroFlowSceneBuilder` AND regenerating `HeroSelect.unity` (a bake — out of
   scope / forbidden in this worktree). I kept the screen in code-built UIElements using
   the **`ElarionUi` palette** (the same black+gold Obsidian language ElarionUiKit sources
   from), so it reads identically. **Decision needed:** accept UI-Toolkit-with-ElarionUi-
   palette (done), or schedule a separate WO to migrate the whole onboarding flow to a
   uGUI/ElarionUiKit host.
2. **Locked-hero treatment.** I made locked heroes **navigable + previewable** (image +
   lore + stats visible) with a LOCK badge + disabled "Coming Soon" CTA — richer than the
   old static dimmed band. If the owner prefers locked heroes hidden entirely (Knight-only
   carousel of one), that's a one-line filter.
3. **Lore source.** Lore = the existing one-sentence `hero.<class>.blurb` from en.json. If
   the owner wants longer lore/bio per hero, add a `hero.<class>.lore` key set (data-only).

## 5. Files modified

- `Assets/_Modules/Onboarding/HeroSelectController.cs` — carousel rebuild (presentation).

(No data files, no scene files, no HeroCatalog change.)
